claims: The NBA features two Play-In Tournament elimination games on Friday, April 17, 2026.
Both games stream on Prime Video.
There is a game at 7:30 PM ET between Charlotte Hornets and Orlando Magic on April 17, 2026.
There is a game at 10:00 PM ET between Golden State Warriors and Phoenix Suns on April 17, 2026.
These games determine the final seeds for the 2026 playoffs.
The 2026 playoffs begin on Saturday, April 18.
